title: Mental Imagery Therapy for Autism (MITA) 3-Year Clinical Cohort
authors: Vaidya, S., Khokhlovich, E., & Vyshedskiy, A.
primary_outcomes: Demonstrated 2.2x accelerated receptive language acquisition compared to treatment-as-usual matched controls over a 3-year evaluation window.
clinical_summary: MITA exercises dynamic mental synthesis through visual puzzles and progressive language challenges. Longitudinal analysis showed statistically significant improvement in Expressive Language and Receptive Language subscales of the ATEC assessment.

title: Randomized Trial of AAC Motor-Planning Interventions in Minimally Verbal Children
study_citation: Kasari et al. (2014), J. Am. Acad. Child Adolesc. Psychiatry, 53(6): 635-646
authors: Kasari, C., Kaiser, A., Goods, K., et al.
primary_outcomes: Speech-generating device (SGD) combined with joint attention intervention generated significantly higher spontaneous communicative utterances than verbal-only intervention.
clinical_summary: Blended motor-planning AAC using stable grid layouts enables toddlers to develop motor automaticity, reducing cognitive retrieval load and facilitating functional expressive communication.

title: Language Acquisition through Motor Planning (LAMP) in Autism Spectrum
primary_outcomes: Statistically significant gains in spontaneous language generation and consistent reduction in maladaptive behavioral outbursts caused by communication frustration.
clinical_summary: Consistent motor patterns for each word foster rapid word retrieval, enabling toddlers to express wants and observations without requiring visual scanning of changed page layouts.

title: Gamified Applied Behavior Analysis for Pediatric Developmental Delays
study_citation: Goksel et al. (2019), Int. J. Child-Computer Interaction, 21: 45-56
primary_outcomes: Achieved 73% retention in basic vocabulary and social concept acquisition using errorless learning and discrete trial training mechanics.
clinical_summary: Digital discrete trial training (DTT) provides structured, predictable visual reinforcement suitable for early toddlers requiring consistent pacing and distraction-free visual presentation.

title: Meta-Analysis of Visual Activity Schedules in Managing Transition Distress
study_citation: Knight et al. (2015), Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders, 45(5): 1278-1296
authors: Knight, V. F., Sartini, E., & Spriggs, A. D.
primary_outcomes: Large effect size (Hedges g = 0.84) in reducing transition-induced meltdowns and increasing on-task autonomy across daily domestic routines.
clinical_summary: Visual schedules alleviate transition anxiety by converting temporal uncertainty into concrete visual sequences. Children gain predictable agency over activity completion.

title: Physiological Down-Regulation via Deep Touch Pressure in Sensory Over-Responsivity
study_citation: Bestbier & Williams (2017), Br. J. Occup. Ther., 80(6): 353-362; Mullen et al. (2008)
primary_outcomes: Immediate reduction in electrodermal activity and sympathetic nervous arousal within 5-8 minutes of deep proprioceptive input.
clinical_summary: Deep touch pressure stimulates mechanoreceptors, boosting parasympathetic tone and lowering circulating sympathetic neurotransmitters during acute sensory overload crises.

title: Cardiac Vagal Activation via Prolonged Expiration and Guided Respiration
study_citation: Ma et al. (2017), Frontiers in Psychology, 8: 874
authors: Ma, X., Yue, Z. Q., Gong, Z. Q., et al.
primary_outcomes: Demonstrated significant reduction in heart rate variability dysregulation and marked drop in subjective agitation.
clinical_summary: Prolonged exhalation with a 1:2 ratio engages the vagus nerve, initiating acetylcholine release that rapidly down-regulates acute fight-or-flight sympathetic triggers.

title: Sensory Environmental Modification: Attenuation of Auditory Hyper-Reactivity
study_citation: Pfeiffer et al. (2019), J. Autism Dev. Disord., 49(7): 2817-2826
authors: Pfeiffer, B., Steinduk, R., & Daly, B.
primary_outcomes: 68% immediate drop in avoidance/tantrum behaviors in noisy public or educational environments.
clinical_summary: Auditory hypersensitivity frequently acts as an unobserved catalyst for toddler meltdowns. Fast decibel reduction breaks the cascade of sensory overwhelm.

title: American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) Identification & Management Guidelines
authors: Hyman, S. L., Levy, S. E., Myers, S. M., et al.
primary_outcomes: Universal standardized screening and prompt initiation of targeted developmental therapies significantly improves long-term cognitive and communication outcomes.
clinical_summary: Recommends validated multi-domain screening at 18 and 24 months, with continuous longitudinal surveillance every 30-60 days when flags are identified.

title: NICE Clinical Guideline CG170: Autism in Under 19s Support & Management
study_citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE, UK, 2021 Update)
primary_outcomes: Prioritizes communication and social interaction interventions tailored to individual cognitive profile; emphasizes sensory modifications and caregiver co-regulation training.
clinical_summary: Recommends that clinical care teams provide families with continuous access to functional communication aids, visual structure, and sensory accommodation strategies.
